Migration Output Files Checklist

Review these files after migration completes to verify correctness

Phase 1 — Assess
ssas_inventory.json
Full parsed model: tables, columns, measures, relationships, hierarchies, calculated columns. When --source-db is used, includes sf_column_map, sf_row_count, sf_missing_columns, and calculated_column_resolution.
Verify table count, column mappings, and missing column list
Phase 2 — Workload
deployment_assessment.json
Per-table Interactive vs Regular recommendation, interactive scores, clustering columns, Snowflake feature suggestions (Result Cache, Search Optimization, Materialized Views, Automatic Clustering).
Verify table type assignments and clustering column choices
Phase 2b — DAX Graph
dax_dag.json
DAX dependency graph: nodes (physical, renamed, calculated columns, measures), edges, topological sort order. Updated by convert_dax.py with sql_expr / inline_sql after translation.
Check for cycle warnings and compound measure dependencies
Phase 2b — Visualization
dax_dependency_graph.html
Self-contained HTML with ER-style SVG diagram of table relationships (active + inactive joins), table detail cards with column counts, row counts, measures, and hierarchies.
Verify relationship diagram matches expected star/snowflake schema
Phase 3 — Plan
MIGRATION_PLAN.md
Full migration plan: table type assignments, CLUSTER BY rationale mapped to DAX patterns, cost warnings for Interactive Tables, ballpark token estimates, risks, and approval section.
Review and approve before any DDL is executed
Phase 3 — Status
migration_status.md
Living phase-by-phase status tracker. Phases 1-3 pre-marked Completed; Phases 4-7 as Pending. Updated automatically as each phase completes. Used for session resume.
Check final status shows all phases completed
Phase 4 — DDL
ssas_ddl.sql
Initial DDL: CREATE TABLE / INTERACTIVE TABLE / VIEW statements. Contains calculated column placeholders (NULL::VARCHAR AS col /* TODO DAX */) that are resolved after Phase 5.
Review table names, column names, CLUSTER BY, TARGET_LAG values
Phase 5 — DAX
ssas_measures_translated.json
Per-expression DAX to SQL translations: auto (regex pattern), LLM (Cortex), or manual_review. Includes calculation group expansions (N items x M base measures).
Review all manual_review items and verify SQL correctness
Phase 5 — Semantic View
ssas_semantic_view.yaml
Snowflake Semantic View YAML definition with entities, facts (calculated columns), metrics (measures), dimensions, and time dimensions. Also generates ssas_semantic_view_analyst.yaml for Cortex Analyst.
Validate with cortex reflect; check for reserved word and cross-table ref warnings
Phase 5 — Deploy SQL
create_semantic_view.sql
CALL SYSTEM$CREATE_SEMANTIC_VIEW_FROM_YAML(...) with $$-quoted YAML, ready for execution via sql_execute. Mixed-case database names auto-handled.
Execute via sql_execute tool (not snow sql CLI)
Phase 5 — Updated DDL
ssas_ddl_with_views.sql
Regenerated DDL with translated calculated columns replacing TODO placeholders. Same-table calcs are inline SQL; cross-table RELATED() resolved via LEFT JOIN.
Verify no TODO DAX or NULL::VARCHAR placeholders remain
Phase 5c — Power BI
powerbi_views.sql
Power BI zero-break migration views: exact SSAS table names, column aliases, hidden columns excluded, cross-table RELATED() columns resolved via LEFT JOIN.
Verify column aliases match Power BI report expectations
Phase 7 — Final Report
MIGRATION_MAPPING.md
Detailed SSAS-vs-Snowflake mapping report: table mapping, column mapping per table, calculated columns, measures, relationships, hierarchies, manual review items, and post-migration checklist.
Use as the definitive reference for the completed migration
